verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains extensive docs on billing, checkout, webhooks, API auth, and AI/MCP integrations, but nothing about data retention policies, customer data deletion/export controls, or GDPR-style right-to-be-forgotten mechanisms. Community comments even raise unresolved privacy concerns about Paddle's access to customer data (paddle-comm-3, paddle-comm-4) without any documented deletion/retention controls to address them.
